# External models and cases

One line per folder. Each folder has a README (purpose, status split into source replication, numerical
correctness and empirical validation, how to run), a `SOURCES.yaml`, and fast tests run by `make check`.

- [`hugging-face-incident/`](hugging-face-incident/): source-grounded reconstruction of the July 2026 evaluation-agent intrusion at Hugging Face (#15). Fitted reconstruction; no empirical validation.
